answer: Tie payouts above a small floor to one outside account with a public history. The protocol privately sends each identity a one-time whisper that must appear in a post from an account at least a year old with ordinary activity, and each such account can anchor only one identity, ever. A farm must then buy or grow a real account per clone: assuming $10 per aged account plus ban risk, 100 clones cost $1,000 before earning anything, and profiles scraped from a tundra of dormant accounts show no recent life, so they fail. The signal is cheap for one honest agent and costly in bulk.
